claim: The merged unified image was attempted by extending mbir_m2_alu.hell (the image that already loads a 7-byte stored program and runs ADD/SUB, 8/8) with a CMP_EQ dispatch case. The patch applies cleanly to 9 regions and introduces no new code flags beyond the two the budget probe allows, but LMAO still rejects the result: the dispatch code itself does not fit in the remaining initializer budget.

base_image.demonstrated: loads a 7-byte stored program and executes ADD/SUB, 8/8 on both engines

changes: OPCODE_PHASE armed before the opcode classification's first decrement
opcode classification extended from 3 to 5 decrements to distinguish 0x02/0x03/0x04
exit_decrement_loop bifurcated by OPCODE_PHASE (the opcode phase reuses SUBROUTINE_FLAG4/5, which op2 later reuses, because each flag is cleared when consumed)
CMP_MODE branches added at the op1 classification tail
cmp_op1_is_0 / _1 / _2 / _ge_3 blocks reusing FLAG_OP2_IS_1/2/3 and the existing res_is_0 / res_is_1 output blocks

errors: Error: Free space exceeded (Add Malbolge command).
Internal error: Cannot generate initialization code for cell 58955.
Error: Memory usage conflict while generating initialization code.
assembly_result.note: cell 58955 is 94 cells short of the 59049 limit

measured_budget.source: m2_alu_budget probe on the same base image
measured_budget.flags_only: 1 flag + 4 cells -> OK (55,443 B); 2 flags + 4 cells -> OK (56,007 B); 3 flags -> FAIL
measured_budget.conclusion: The two flags the design needs DO fit. What does not fit is the dispatch code itself: the extended opcode classification, the second exit block and the CMP_EQ result blocks together need roughly 40-80 more cells than the 3,042-cell margin that remains after the two flags.

what_this_means_for_b: mbir_m2_alu.hell is already the unified image for the arithmetic half: one image, stored program loaded into RAM, ADD and SUB executed (8/8).
Adding CMP_EQ to that same image is blocked by the initializer budget, not by semantics: the code needs ~40-80 cells more than remain.

The constructive route is the other side of the same measurement: mbir_m2_loader.hell has 18,740 bytes of headroom and admits 512 data cells and 8 new code flags (loader_budget_probe.json). The unified image should be built on the loader's andamio, which is where the room is, not by extending the arithmetic image that is already 96% full.
what_remains_not_demonstrated: One image that loads a stored program AND executes ADD/SUB/CMP_EQ (this attempt).
The comparator inside that same image.
A borrow-propagating HeLL comparator with the 5+2 xlat2 technique (E1 design, never built).
scope_limits: Only the CMP_EQ dispatch was attempted; CMP_LT was not added.
The patch is a proof of mechanism, not a tuned image; a leaner encoding of the same dispatch might fit, but was not searched.
